maya: New model intake: kepler-14b-v0.9
Quick summary: decoder-only 14B (open checkpoint) from Kepler Labs. Promising LM/perf on internal eval. Asking for quant experiments, catalog entry, docs, and announcement coordination.
Ask: can owners pick up the checklist below? Target: smoke quant + catalog draft by EOD tomorrow, release/announce next Wed if no regressions.
Checklist:
- Quant sweep (8/6/4-bit) + perf (latency/cost) — owner: sam
- Eval run (cohort QA, LM, safety slices) — owner: maya
- Model catalog entry + docs — owner: lucas
- Announcement draft + release schedule — owner: hara
- Staging rollout plan + canary metrics — owner: oliver
Notes: model supports streaming & function-calling; KV-cache friendly; tested up to 8k ctx. Weights: https://internal-storage/kepler-14b/v0.9 :eyes:

sam: I'll take quant. Running quick sweep on dedicated-qa tomorrow morning. Quick smoke results I got locally (A100-80GB, 8k ctx):
- fp16: ppl=11.8, 1-token latency=0.16s
- int8: ppl=12.1, 1-token latency=0.095s
- int4 (experimental): ppl=13.6, 1-token latency=0.07s
I'll push bench artifacts to /runs/kepler-14b/177654.
Quick run command I use:
```
./bench_quant --model kepler-14b/v0.9 --bits 8 --dataset eval-lm --ctx 8192 --batch 1
```
If ppl delta > 1.5 for int4 we should gate it. :thumbsup:

lucas: I'll draft the catalog entry + docs page. Need from you @maya: recommended quant profile (which of sam's results to endorse), provenance notes, and a 1-line blurb for the catalog. Draft ETA: 48h. Using template: https://docs-internal/model-catalog/template.md

hara: Marketing note — public announce needs ~1 week lead. If we want an internal launch next Wed we need final QA by Fri. I'll draft announcement skeleton but will hold publish until perf + safety sign-off. Also will schedule customer preview for Dedicated customers once we have canary metrics.

oliver: For staging rollout I'll create a canary route at 5% traffic and monitor latency, error rate, and hallucination regressions (via eval hooks). Need model tag and canary config from lucas/maya. ETA to spin up: ~6h after quant smoke artifacts are in. Rollback policy: auto-fallback to kepler-14b-v0.8 on error spike.

deploy-bot: Staging cluster quota check — GPUs available in us-west-2: 3/4. Reserve request for 2 x p4d (submitted by sam).

maya: Thanks — recap of action items: 
- sam: quant sweep + upload artifacts (/runs/kepler-14b/177654)
- maya: eval slices + safety checks (cohort QA, targeted prompts)
- lucas: catalog + docs draft (include streaming/function-calling flags)
- hara: announcement skeleton & scheduling
- oliver: canary config + rollback policy
Let's sync tomorrow 10:00am PT in #eng-ml if blockers. Ping me in thread with any infra needs. :raised_hands:
